title: Negative Staining of Macromolecules for Electron Microscopy Analysis
author: Jillian C Danne

steps.title: Prepare and Glow Discharge the Grid
steps.instruction: Prepare the carbon support film grid for sample application using glow discharge.

substeps.instruction: Wrap a piece of parafilm around a glass slide.
Place a QUANTIFOIL carbon support film grid or custom made carbon coated formvar grid on the parafilm, carbon side up.
Glow discharge the grid on the slide for 30 seconds at 30mA (e.g., using PELCO easiGlow TM Glow Discharge Cleaning System).

steps.title: Prepare Sample Solution on Parafilm
steps.instruction: Set up the sample solution on a clean surface.

substeps.instruction: Place a sheet of parafilm on a clean flat bench, glass board, or large glass petri dish lid, using a small amount of water underneath to keep the parafilm flat.
Pipette 5-10 μl of sample solution onto the clean parafilm surface.

steps.title: Apply Sample to Grid
steps.instruction: Incubate the grid in the sample solution.

substeps.instruction: Float the grid in the sample solution drop carbon side down for 1-3 minutes.

steps.title: Blot Excess Sample
steps.instruction: Remove excess sample solution from the grid.

substeps.instruction: Place a sheet of parafilm underneath a piece of filter paper to prevent contamination of the bench surface.
Pick up the grid using fine forceps.
Tilt the grid at a 45-60 degree angle and bring it to the filter paper to blot away the excess solution, taking care not to damage the carbon support film.

steps.title: Prepare Uranyl Acetate Stain
steps.instruction: Apply the negative stain to the parafilm surface.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 10-50 μl of 0.5-2% aqueous uranyl acetate (filtered, stored in dark/foil) onto the same clean parafilm surface.

steps.title: Stain the Grid
steps.instruction: Incubate the grid in the uranyl acetate solution.

substeps.instruction: Using fine forceps, transfer the grid to the uranyl acetate drop sample side down.

steps.title: Blot Excess Stain
steps.instruction: Remove excess uranyl acetate from the grid.

substeps.instruction: Blot away the excess uranyl acetate solution using the same method as used for the sample (filter paper on parafilm).
If staining is insufficient, increase incubation time or repeat the sample application and staining steps.
Place the grid on a sheet of filter paper sample side up.
Cover with a glass petri dish and dry for 10 minutes.
Store grids in a grid storage box.

steps.title: Image the Sample
steps.instruction: Load the grid into the TEM for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Place a grid in a transmission electron microscope grid holder (e.g., JEOL JEM-1400-Plus TEM at 80 keV equipped with a high sensitivity bottom mount CMOS 'Flash' camera).
